invoke: Invoke: how much {resource_name} do you spend?
deal_damage: Choose a unit to deal {amount} damage to.
heal: Choose an ally unit to give {amount} HP.
scout_draw: You look at the top {count} card(s) of your deck. Choose one to draw.
deal_damage_tier: Choose a tier: every unit there takes {amount} damage.
play_from_discard: Choose a spell from your discard pile to play.
discard_from_hand: You may discard a card from your hand.
move_played_to_deck: You may put one of these cards on the {position} of your deck.
scout_discard: You look at the top {count} card(s). Choose any to discard; the rest stay on top in the same order.
refresh_count: How many times do you refresh your market (free)?
discard_from_market: Choose a card to discard from the {market_name}.
deal_damage_opponent: Choose a unit of {player_name} to deal {amount} damage to.
disrupt: Choose a card from {player_name}'s hand. They discard it.
reveal_for: You may reveal {count} {element_name} cards from your hand. They can't be played this turn.
shuffle_into_deck: Choose up to {count} card(s) to shuffle from your discard pile into your deck.
scout_rest: What happens to the other scouted cards?
scout_order: Put the cards back in the order you want (first = top of your deck).
boost_unit: Choose an ally unit to boost.
stun_units: Choose up to {count} unit(s) to stun.
shield_units: Choose up to {count} unit(s) to shield.
freeze_units: Choose up to {count} unit(s) to freeze.
bounce: Choose an enemy unit to return to its owner's hand.
resolve_market_card: Choose a shared-market card (cost {max_cost} or less) to resolve.
destroy: Choose a unit of {player_name} to kill.
destroy_tier: Choose a tier: every unit there is killed.
sacrifice: You may kill another of your units.
